newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean state-backed LPMO buys 9,145T frozen beef.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean state-backed LPMO buys 9,145T frozen beef.

text.p: South Korea's state-backed Livestock Products Marketing Organization (LPMO) bought 9,145 tonnes of frozen beef on Friday through a tender, traders in Seoul said.
But the organisation passed on tenders for 468 tonnes of frozen beef as it originally sought to buy a total of 9,613 tonnes, they said.
They said the organisation would seek to buy the 468 tonnes -- 432 tonnes of grass-fed fullsets and 36 tonnes of grass-fed bone-in beef -- on September 17 as per its original plan.
The LPMO announced the tender on Thursday and said that if it passed due to high prices, it would re-tender on September 17.
LPMO officials were not immediately available for comment.
Traders said the organisation bought 6,030 tonnes of Australian grassfed beef, 276 tonnes of New Zealand grassfed beef, 2,605 tonnes of U.S. chuck roll and 234 tonnes of Canadian chuck roll.
A source said the tender was split into three positions -- 2,888 tonnes for shipment by October 15, 3,110 tonnes by October 25 and 3,147 tonnes by November 5.
Arrivals were set for Seoul, Pusan, Taegu and Naju.
Further details could not be acquired immediately.
